Download PES 2020 Mod FIFA 14 Offline Apk Obb Data  For Android, with latest players tranfers, legends players, new kits and stadium.

Some of you reading this post will ask why PES Mod FIFA on Android, yes this is a fan base mod that is developed with Pro Evolution Soccer 2020 logos and emblems, background colours and more.

FIFA 14 Mod PES 2020 Android game runs completely offline which is similar to FIFA 20 Mod already released on this website.

Just like any other Mod Of FIFA, this PES 20 Mod Apk offline also has free kick off matches, where you can select from different related leagues available in the world.

Career mode or manager mode just got better, despite being tested by me, there’s no any issues of closing during gameplay, controling of players goes smoothly.

Tournament mode is also available, where you can play from different tournament Leagues such as premier League, Italian leagues, FIFA world cup, FA cup etc.

In addition to the career mode or manager mode, you will have unlimited amount of money to manager your team, you can also generate more virtual money by selling tickets for home matches.

Sponsors also pay you virtual money bonus for every match you win in career mode, this virtual currency can be used to buy players during transfers and loan season.

PES 2020 Mod FIFA 14 offline for Android has a good graphic, new pitch design, wide PS4 camera, stadium banners showing different adverts.

Control buttons are bigger now, making it easy for you to quickly control or move players to any part of the pitch, control buttons functions available are: Sprint  Shoot, Pass, Throw, switch, 2nd Call, skill move. 

Commentary or speech is available for everyone to download in different languages such as English, French, Spain, Italy and more.

Player movements and skills is superb as players move quickly to score and react quickly to attack or dribble opponents before they get the chance to score.

The replay function is working well, you can quickly replay how a your player scored a particular goal or just to see his real face.

Players now have real face with full kits just like in the real world, for example Messi appearance looks so real similar to the likes of Mohammed Salah, Christiano Ronaldo and many players that you know.

Full transfers of player have been done and updated in PES 2020 eFootball Mod FIFA 14, that is season  2019/20 player transfers, all players are in there rightful clubs.
